title: SARS-CoV-2 RdRp Nested RT-PCR Protocol
author: Judy A Northill
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgz2jx8e
materials: SuperScript III One-Step RT-PCR System with Platinum Taq Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #12574026 MyFi Mix Bioline Catalog #BIO-25049 Round 1 mix Dispense mix in 15µl amounts in 0.2ml PCR tubes suitable for thermocycler. Mix maybe stored frozen if necessary. Round 2 mix Dispense mix in 15µl amounts in 0.2ml PCR tubes suitable for thermocycler. Mix maybe stored frozen if necessary.

Thaw required number of tubes with round 1 mix. Add 5µl of extract, control, or NTC (nuclease-free water) to round 1 mix above for a final reaction volume of 20µl. Label the tubes and record details. The assay has been used with Eppendorf thermocyclers. PCR cycling times

steps.title: Dilute Round 1 Amplicons
steps.instruction: Dilute each of the round 1 amplicons 1/100 in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2μl of amplicon with 198μl of nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Prepare Round 2 PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the Round 2 PCR reaction with a total volume of 20μl.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the required number of tubes containing the round 2 mix.
Add 5μl of the diluted round 1 amplicon to the mix.

steps.title: Analyze Amplified Products
steps.instruction: Analyze the amplified products using gel electrophoresis or equipment such as a QIAxcel or equivalent.

substeps.instruction: Verify that Round 1 amplified products produce a band of 605bp.
Verify that Round 2 amplified products produce a band of 440bp.
Confirm that no template controls (NTC) are detected.
